command: ETLANTIC_CP_TEST_URL=<isolated PostgreSQL service URL> uv run pytest -q tests/prefect/test_managed_prefect_0_58.py
assertions: The two PostgreSQL-gated tests ran without skips, including single-claim/retry-identity behavior and separate Prefect Process-worker execution.
A separate Process worker executed the dispatched target, left another accepted submission untouched, and published canonical results.
Replace-mode CSV-to-PostgreSQL and PostgreSQL-to-PostgreSQL runs produced the expected rows and effect records.
Prefect deployment registration and remote deployment binding were verified.

runtime.prefect_server: Prefect temporary test server with its own SQLite test database

limitations: The run used the uv-managed editable development environment rather than clean installed wheels.
The submitting process stayed alive during worker execution.
Prefect used its temporary SQLite test server, not a separately supervised self-hosted server with PostgreSQL storage.
This smoke does not cover crash/lost-response recovery, cancellation races, API restart parity, tenant isolation, recurring schedules, least-privilege grants, or upgrade/rollback.
